name: Moonglade
label: Quest
description: Moonglade: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: All adventurers are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade. Keeper Remulos--Moonglade's guardian--keeps watch over all adventurers who hibernate there. I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.
As for your first lesson here on Azeroth, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young adventurer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah I see that you have already mastered the form of the Bear. Good, good. You are well on your way, young adventurer.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
